annotations.title: Verify Outer Loop Stop With Zero-Turn Defect-Only Gate

description: Approve zero-overhead completion when pendingDiffsCount=0 and output has 0 objective defects while blocking unverified code diffs, upstream source fingerprint drift (INV-GH-14), unexplained panics/stubs (INV-GH-15), empty/null/NaN bailouts, truncations, raw DataFrame/numpy reprs, and leaked <tool_call> tags.

audited_files.description: Optional edited fallible modules audited for unexplained unwrap/panic!/process.exit/todo! (INV-GH-15).

candidate_answer.description: Optional structured or scalar final answer value.

current_file_digests.description: Optional current file SHA-256 map checked against Turn-0 baseline digests (INV-GH-14).

expect_non_empty_answer.description: Flag empty/null/NaN/[]/{} bailouts as output defects.

finish_reason.description: Optional provider finish reason (e.g., STOP, MAX_TOKENS).

workspace_dir.description: Optional workspace directory used to verify upstream baseline SHA-256 digests (INV-GH-14).

name: krusch_grounded_verify_stop
